rows.label: Disability weight of severe major depressive disorder (GBD 2016)

source.title: Global Burden of Disease Study 2016, disability weights (IHME)
source.note: As used in Founders Pledge's StrongMinds (2018) and Action for Happiness (2020) analyses

rows.explainer: How much of a year of healthy life a year of severe major depression costs, by the Global Burden of Disease 2016 weights. Founders Pledge spreads it over the PHQ-9 depression scale to value a fall in depression score.
